scientific_integrity: Analytical proof is self-contained; reproducible symbolic and numerical checks are supplemental. The underlying one-factor/tetrad identities and FA formulation are prior art. Strict positive uniqueness is not attained in the representable boundary patterns.
scientific_limitations: Only real diagonal strictly stable Lyapunov dynamics, rank-one forcing, zero initial covariance, dimension at least three, nonzero forcing components.
The exact stationary witness uses three damping rates and is not a general Riccati-flow impossibility result.
The Frobenius lower bound is explicit but does not solve the complete optimal approximation problem.
Cubic order is a fixed-parameter short-time asymptotic. An independent priority review has not been performed.
title: Exact one-factor representability and sharp cubic distance for diagonal Lyapunov Gramians
